description: Theoretical sandwich-attack profit for a swap of a given size in one DEX pool, at the pool's current reserves (DexScreener) and the swap's slippage tolerance: the largest front-run that still lets the victim's trade succeed, and the profit it would give. Constant-product pools only, no mempool view, no competing bots: a worst-case estimate, not a prediction. Suggests a slippage tolerance. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

amount.description: Victim's input amount in that token's units

chain.description: DexScreener chain name, e.g. base, ethereum (default base)

side.description: sell = victim gives base token; buy = victim gives quote token (default sell)

slippagePct.description: Victim's slippage tolerance in percent, 0 to 50 (default 1)

name: agent_intel_mev_sandwich_risk_analyzer
title: Agent Intel Mev Sandwich Risk Analyzer
